reading_method: All unique complete contents were displayed and processed in bounded full-text tool reads by root and three reading agents. Truncated attempts were not counted and were reread. Identical complete copies were verified by SHA256. No summary or script-only byte access substitutes for reading.
limitations: Supporting repository and installed-game files linked by sources are inspected after this gate where available. No native HOI4 tool or gameplay validation claim.

packaging_verification.verification: SHA-256 recheck of every supplied text instance against the completed full-reading receipt. This verification supplements actual recorded full reads, not a substitute for them.
